Rates as of 2024: Mother's Day - Labor Day $45/night (tents $15); hunting season (Labor Day weekend - Dec 17) full hookups $35, dry camping $20; off season (Dec 17 - May 26) $20/night for all spots, no tenting.
'Call for reservations or more information! (406) 557-6144' (also 208-264-8305). Owner/manager on site.

note: Remote prairie stop on MT-200 (~32 mi W of Jordan) at 3198 Hwy 200 W: RV sites by the general store/cafe, with tent and dry-camping room when the hookup sites are full. Pets and horses welcome (bring temporary fencing; Coggins, a Montana brand inspection and, from out of state, a health certificate required before unloading). Also a hostel. Near Hell Creek Recreation Area on Fort Peck Lake. --Claude
summary: Operator's site is dead, so read from its 2024 Wayback captures: 7 full-hookup 30-40 amp sites (most pull-through, any size), showers, store/cafe, Wi-Fi, open all year, $20-45 (2024), reservations by phone. Changed: site count 8 (note) -> 7 in the note; electric 30 added; showers confirmed. Not stated: site lengths, laundry. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Dead website: www.sandspringsmontana.com does not resolve (2026-10-22) and the Wayback Machine's latest capture (2024-11-23) is already a Wix 'ConnectYourDomain' error, so the site has been down for about two years. Presence rule: a human should check Google Maps (open, 25+ reviews, phone) or Facebook to confirm the store and RV park still operate.

Private price gate: 2024 rates $45/night summer full hookup, $35 hunting season, $20 off season; under US$50, but the rates are from a 2024 archive and could not be re-checked. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grasslands NP 239 km).
Phone: the operator also listed 208-264-8305 alongside 406-557-6144 (the entry's number matches the first).
